job.title: Sr. Software Engineer
job.description: GoodRx is the leading prescription savings platform in the U.S. Trusted by more than 25 million consumers and 750,000 healthcare professionals annually, GoodRx provides access to savings and affordability options for generic and brand-name medications at more than 70,000 pharmacies nationwide, as well as comprehensive healthcare research and information.
responsibilities: Utilize frontend skills to solve complex customer experience problems across multiple surfaces and user journeys
Collaborate with web developers to design and evolve frontend frameworks, components, and services
Design and implement scalable frontend architecture and patterns that are stable, flexible, and a pleasure to use
Define and influence coding standards and best practices
Improve and maintain CI/CD pipelines and frontend developer workflows
Write unit tests for new features, and improve coverage for existing ones
Create and participate in code reviews
Evaluate and introduce new technologies and frameworks
Independently lead development of complex features from concept through launch
Collaborate with Backend engineers to design APIs that can support frontend features
Mentor and support the growth of other engineers

positioning: Prioritize bullets showing ownership, reliability, and cross-functional delivery impact.
project_suggestions: Highlight projects touching TypeScript, state management patterns Context, Redux
gap_analysis: Add quantified outcomes (latency, uptime, delivery speed, or cost savings) where possible.
